definition: a thing I depend on solely because of something else I depend on

settled:
Some of what I lean on is only there to serve something else I lean on.

Venmo sits downstream of Facebook Marketplace. If Marketplace leaves the graph the Venmo need shrinks with it.

The Costco card has to be a Citi card, because Citi is the only issuer Costco works with. So trusting Costco at B buys me a Citi dependency at D. Untangling it means either giving up the cashback or carrying the Citi card as the price of Costco.

So I cannot weigh a downstream one on its own. Its real weight is set by the upstream need that created it.

My ranking still treats each one separately, which is a gap in the ranking.

title: A Dependency That Only Exists For Another One
